units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26">Ex. R. s. 26</cite> <he>אין מידתי … מכה באזמל ומרפא בר׳ וכ׳</he> my (God’s) way is not like the way of man (surgeon), who wounds with a knife and heals with a plaster, but I &c.; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 50">ib. 50</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>, end; Mekh. B’shall., s. 5; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:5:1">Cant. R. to IV, 5</cite> <he>בו״ד אין מקדים ר׳ וכ׳</he> a human being does not prepare the plaster before he sees the wound, but not so the Lord, he prepares the plaster &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 312:1">Yalk. Jer. 312</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:11">Tosef. Pes. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:3">III</cite>), 3; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רְטִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:9">Ex. R. s. 27</cite> <he>ונמצא כולו ר׳</he> finally his body is covered all over with plasters.
